controls: Click tubes or press keys 1-9 to select source and destination

semantic_event_mapping.POUR: native POUR records a single accepted maximal source-to-destination transfer

assumptions: Keyboard and pointer selection resolve through the same native numeric selection actions.
Maximal contiguous same-color run pours into empty or same-color destination space.
Visual liquid is read-only; no model-authored certification claim is made.
Source and usage budgets are unverified.
invalid_index_behavior: Numeric selection and explicit source/destination indices are zero-based integers; invalid values reject without mutation or events.
